text.div: ObservationDefinition Uniformity of dosage units - Uniformity of dosage units (NIR, RTRT): Batch release When 200 uncoated tablets, sampled to represent the whole batch during the tableting process, are tested for Assay, the number of tablets exceeding 85.0%-115.0% is 6 or less and exceeding 75.0%-125% is 1 or less.
